svg.title: Speculative Decode Round (140 W Budget)
svg.desc:
Speculative Decode Round (140 W Budget) CUDA-graphed draft, target verify, and exact Leviathan acceptance on 1x CMP 170HX States shown: Live. Solid lines: data flows today.
Blocks, left to right: - Active Batch (N <= 8 sessions / card): Up to 8 active slots; Anchor token + pos; Paged global KV; SWA-1024 rings - DSpark Drafter (Default (or DFlash2 opt-in)): 3-layer draft model; 7-step Markov loop; top_p = 0.90 filter; 58-node CUDA graph - Verbatim Lookup (Appended suffix drafts): Verbatim n-gram match; --lookup 8 --lookup-min 8; Ptok3 gated width; Zero VRAM overhead - Target Verify (Bit-invariant vs 1-row): 1..16 rows per slot; NVFP4_N1S1 MoE GEMM; Single-pass 16-row attn; Fused router + AttnRes - Exact Acceptance (3.00-3.14 tok/rd mean): 128-bit Leviathan; Rejection + residual; Commit accepted KV; Instant draft rollback Groups: - Proposal (up to 15 drafts): DSpark Drafter, Verbatim Lookup Lines: - Active Batch -> DSpark Drafter, labeled "anchor" - Active Batch -> Verbatim Lookup, labeled "token history" - DSpark Drafter -> Target Verify, labeled "<= 7 drafts" - Verbatim Lookup -> Target Verify, labeled "<= 8 suffix" - Target Verify -> Exact Acceptance, labeled "target logits" - Exact Acceptance -> Active Batch, labeled "accepted tokens -> next anchor" Note: Verified exact. 0/8,000 greedy argmax mismatches; 13/13 sdist tests (425,984 draws, 0 zero-prob draws).
